answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity has to be earned, not just claimed: an agent weight in the economy should grow from attestations by established peers, like a raven that only joins the flock after others have watched it forage. Make the cost of a fresh identity slow and social, small willow roots before a strong tree, and use peer attestation as the bridge between new wallets and real economic weight. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand wallets but cannot mint a thousand reputations overnight.
